title: Elwynn Forest
content: Elwynn Forest is the level 1-10 starting zone for humans, just outside Stormwind City. New characters begin at Northshire Abbey, then move to Goldshire, the main town, with its Lion's Pride Inn. Common enemies are wolves, kobolds in the mines and Defias bandits.

title: Durotar
content: Durotar is the level 1-10 starting zone for orcs and trolls, outside Orgrimmar. New characters begin in the Valley of Trials, then quest from Razor Hill and Sen'jin Village near the Echo Isles. Common enemies are boars, scorpids, Razormane quilboar and Burning Blade cultists.

title: Teldrassil
content: Teldrassil is the level 1-10 starting zone for night elves, on the giant tree that holds Darnassus. New characters begin in Shadowglen beneath Aldrassil, then quest from Dolanaar. Common enemies are nightsabers, spiders and corrupted furbolgs, and the boat at Rut'theran Village goes to Darkshore.

title: Mulgore
content: Mulgore is the level 1-10 starting zone for tauren, below Thunder Bluff. New characters begin at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, then quest from Bloodhoof Village. Common enemies are plainstriders, prairie wolves, Palemane gnolls, Bristleback quilboar and Venture Company miners.

title: Dun Morogh
content: Dun Morogh is the level 1-10 starting zone for dwarves and gnomes, around Ironforge. New characters begin at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, then quest from Kharanos and its Thunderbrew Distillery inn. Common enemies are Rockjaw troggs, Frostmane trolls, boars and wolves.

title: Tirisfal Glades
content: Tirisfal Glades is the level 1-10 starting zone for the undead, above the Undercity. New characters rise in Deathknell, then quest from the town of Brill. Common enemies are mindless zombies, Scourge, and the Scarlet Crusade, whose monastery sits in the zone's north.

title: Borean Tundra
content: Borean Tundra is a level 68-72 Northrend zone. Alliance arrive by boat at Valiance Keep and Horde by zeppelin at Warsong Hold. Its quests fight the Scourge, nerubians and the blue dragonflight, whose Nexus stands on Coldarra in the zone's west.

title: Howling Fjord
content: Howling Fjord is a level 68-72 Northrend zone. Alliance arrive by boat at Valgarde and Horde by zeppelin at Vengeance Landing. Its quests fight the vrykul, whose stronghold Utgarde Keep is the zone's dungeon, and the Forsaken's plague works at New Agamand.
